exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "Must/Have to".

options.text: A とか B とか
～なくてはいけない
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! ～なくてはいけない matches "Must/Have to".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is ～なくてはいけない.
exercises.explanation: Used to show something is necessary or must be done.

exercises.question: Choose the correct meaning for: ～なくてはいけない.

exercises.correctFeedback: Correct! ～なくてはいけない means "Must/Have to".
